title: The Example Module
_comment: The story lane validates flag changes against this spine. Gates constrain WHAT may become true; endings constrain HOW the story may resolve. Neither constrains which path the table takes to get there.

gates.desc: The door cannot open before the village has been warned — everything downstream assumes they had the chance to leave.
Ringing three times with the door shut is survivable but breaks the escalation the ending depends on.
